---
title: "Colocalization and LD-overlap analyses of plasma metabolites and sleep traits"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    code_folding: show
---

This document integrates all numbered scripts in the former **Colocalization** folder in execution order: abf colocalization, nearest-gene annotation, SuSiE colocalization with a local LD panel, LD-based instrument-overlap clustering, and multi-trait HyPrColoc. Replace `"Path"` once in the setup chunk. Inputs are read through the shared `Data` structure, and all outputs are written to `Colocalization/outputs` without run-date suffixes.

## Integrated setup and relative paths

```{r coloc-00-setup, include=FALSE}
# Source file: integrated setup from all Colocalization files
# Integrated setup shared by every chunk.
project_root <- normalizePath("Path", winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)

data_dir               <- file.path(project_root, "Data")
metabolite_gwas_dir    <- file.path(data_dir, "Metabolite_GWAS")
sleep_gwas_dir         <- file.path(data_dir, "Sleep_GWAS")
reference_dir          <- file.path(data_dir, "Reference")
ld_bfile               <- file.path(data_dir, "LD_Reference", "EUR")

code_dir               <- file.path(project_root, "MetaboliteSleep_Code")
mr_code_dir            <- file.path(code_dir, "MR")
coloc_code_dir         <- file.path(code_dir, "Colocalization")
mr_output_dir          <- file.path(mr_code_dir, "outputs")
coloc_output_dir       <- file.path(coloc_code_dir, "outputs")

dir.create(coloc_output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

catalog_file            <- file.path(reference_dir, "gwas_catalog_summary_statistics_table_export.tsv")
sleep_trait_file        <- file.path(reference_dir, "GWAS_sleep_trait.xlsx")
pathway_file            <- file.path(reference_dir, "20231120_metabolite_pathway.xlsx")
significant_mr_file      <- file.path(mr_output_dir, "metabolite_sleep_primary_fdrmethod0.05.xlsx")
lipid_iv_file           <- file.path(reference_dir, "Ivs_LipidSleepDur.xlsx")

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(MendelianRandomization)
  library(dplyr)
  library(data.table)
  library(readxl)
  library(openxlsx)
  library(TwoSampleMR)
  library(plinkbinr)
  library(ieugwasr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(mr.raps)
  library(coloc)
  library(stringr)
  library(susieR)
  library(vautils)
  library(pheatmap)
  library(hyprcoloc)
  library(cluster)
})
```

## 1. Approximate Bayes factor colocalization in ±500 kb windows

Each sleep-trait chunk harmonizes the metabolite and sleep summary statistics, restricts the region to ±500 kb around the metabolite lead SNP, and runs `coloc.abf`.

**Analysis block.** Select metabolites for colocalization.

```{r coloc-01-01-select-colocalization-metabolites}
# Source file: 1_colocalization_abf_500kb.Rmd
all_res<-read_excel(significant_mr_file, sheet = "Sheet 1")

# Select metabolite levels only (exclude ratio variables)
all_res<-subset(all_res,gene_shared_protein == "NA")
```

**Analysis block.** Configure shared paths.

```{r coloc-01-02-configure-paths}
# Source file: 1_colocalization_abf_500kb.Rmd
dat_dir <- metabolite_gwas_dir
file_dir <- coloc_output_dir
```

**Analysis block.** Obtain metabolite sample sizes from GWAS Catalog.

```{r coloc-01-03-catalog-sample-size}
# Source file: 1_colocalization_abf_500kb.Rmd
catalog<-fread(catalog_file)

catalog<-subset(catalog,catalog$firstAuthor=="Chen Y")
catalog<-subset(catalog,catalog$pubmedId=="36635386")

catalog$Ancestry<- sapply(catalog$discoverySampleAncestry,function(x){
        temp <- strsplit(x, split = " ")[[1]][2]
				return(as.character(temp))	
				})
catalog<-subset(catalog,catalog$Ancestry=="European")

catalog$exposure<- sapply(catalog$accessionId,function(x){
        temp <- strsplit(x, split = "T")[[1]][2]
				return(as.character(temp))	
				})

catalog$N<- sapply(catalog$discoverySampleAncestry,function(x){
        temp <- strsplit(x, split = " ")[[1]][1]
				return(as.numeric(temp))	
				})
catalog<-catalog[,c("exposure","N")]
```

**Analysis block.** Long sleep duration.

```{r coloc-01-04-long-sleep-duration}
# Source file: 1_colocalization_abf_500kb.Rmd
load(file.path(sleep_gwas_dir, "30846698", "long_sleep_duration_unadjBMI_UKB_2019_allSNP_hg38.RData"))
longsleepduration <- get("dat_allSNP_hg38")
rm(dat_allSNP_hg38)

# Initialize the colocalization summary table
coloc_res<-data.frame(metabolite=NA,sleep=NA,nsnps=NA,PPH0=NA,PPH1=NA,PPH2=NA,PPH3=NA,PPH4=NA,snp=NA,position=NA,V.df1=NA,z.df1=NA,r.df1=NA,lABF.df1=NA,V.df2=NA,z.df2=NA,r.df2=NA,lABF.df2=NA,internal.sum.lABF=NA,SNP.PP.H4=NA)

for (sleepty in c("longsleepduration")) {
  
  # Select metabolites significant for this sleep trait
  signif_res<-subset(all_res,all_res$outcome==sleepty)
  
  id<-unique(signif_res$exposure)
  
  longsleepduration<- longsleepduration[order(longsleepduration$P,decreasing = FALSE),]
  longsleepduration<- longsleepduration[!duplicated(longsleepduration$SNP),]
  
  for (metaboliteid in id) {
    metabolite<-fread(paste(dat_dir,"GCST",metaboliteid,".tsv.gz",sep = ""))
    
    metabolite<- metabolite[order(metabolite$p_value,decreasing = FALSE),]
    metabolite<- metabolite[!duplicated(metabolite$variant_id),]
    
    setnames(metabolite,"variant_id","SNP")
    
    metabolite_N<-catalog[catalog$exposure==metaboliteid,][[2]]
    
    load(paste(file.path(mr_output_dir, "harmonise_data"), "/", metaboliteid, "_longsleepduration_har3.RData", sep = ""))
    top_chr<- exp_out_har3[order(exp_out_har3$pval.exposure,
                                 decreasing = FALSE),][1,]$chr.exposure
    top_bp<- exp_out_har3[order(exp_out_har3$pval.exposure,
                                 decreasing = FALSE),][1,]$pos.exposure
    
    metabolite<-subset(metabolite,base_pair_location>top_bp-500000 & base_pair_location<top_bp+500000 & chromosome==top_chr)
    sleept<-subset(longsleepduration,BP>top_bp-500000 & BP<top_bp+500000 & CHR==top_chr)
    
    input <- merge(sleept, metabolite, by="SNP", 
                     all=FALSE, suffixes=c(".sl",".mt"))
    
    metabolite_format<-format_data(input,type = "exposure",snps = NULL,header = TRUE,snp_col = "SNP",chr_col = "chromosome",pos_col = "base_pair_location",effect_allele_col = "effect_allele",other_allele_col = "other_allele",eaf_col = "effect_allele_frequency",beta_col = "beta",se_col = "standard_error",pval_col = "p_value")
    sleep_format<-format_data(input,type = "outcome",snps = input$SNP,header = TRUE,snp_col = "SNP",chr_col = "CHR",pos_col = "BP",effect_allele_col = "Effect_Allele",other_allele_col = "Other_Allele",eaf_col = "EAF",beta_col = "BETA",se_col = "BETA_SE",pval_col = "P")
    har<-harmonise_data(metabolite_format,sleep_format,action = 2)
    har<-subset(har,har$mr_keep==TRUE)
    har$MAF<-ifelse(har$eaf.exposure<0.5,har$eaf.exposure,1-har$eaf.exposure)

    result <- coloc.abf(dataset1=list(snp=har$SNP,beta=har$beta.outcome,
                                      varbeta=(har$se.outcome)^2,position=har$pos.outcome, 
                                      type="cc"), 
                        dataset2=list(snp=har$SNP,beta=har$beta.exposure,
                                      varbeta=(har$se.exposure)^2,position=har$pos.exposure,
                                      type="quant",N=metabolite_N,MAF=har$MAF))
  
    need_result=(result$results %>% dplyr::arrange(desc(SNP.PP.H4)))[1,]
    
    #record results
    need_result$metabolite<-metaboliteid
    need_result$sleep<-sleepty
    need_result$nsnps<-result[["summary"]][["nsnps"]]
    need_result$PPH0<-result[["summary"]][["PP.H0.abf"]]
    need_result$PPH1<-result[["summary"]][["PP.H1.abf"]]
    need_result$PPH2<-result[["summary"]][["PP.H2.abf"]]
    need_result$PPH3<-result[["summary"]][["PP.H3.abf"]]
    need_result$PPH4<-result[["summary"]][["PP.H4.abf"]]
    
    coloc_res<-rbind(coloc_res,need_result)
    rm(metabolite)
    rm(input)
  }
}

coloc_res<-coloc_res[-1,]

write.csv(coloc_res,file = file.path(file_dir, "metabolite_longsleepduration_colocalization_500kb_res.csv"))

rm(longsleepduration)
```

```{r coloc-01-05-short-sleep-duration}
                                 decreasing = FALSE),][1,]$chr.exposure
    top_bp<- exp_out_har3[order(exp_out_har3$pval.exposure,

    metabolite<-subset(metabolite,base_pair_location>top_bp-500000 & base_pair_location<top_bp+500000 & chromosome==top_chr)

    sleep_format<-format_data(input,type = "outcome",snps = input$SNP,header = TRUE,snp_col = "SNP",chr_col = "CHR",pos_col = "BP",effect_allele_col = "Effect_Allele",other_allele_col = "Other_Allele",eaf_col = "EAF",beta_col = "BETA",se_col = "BETA_SE",pval_col = "P")
    har<-harmonise_data(metabolite_format,sleep_format,action = 2)
    har<-subset(har,har$mr_keep==TRUE)
    har$MAF<-ifelse(har$eaf.exposure<0.5,har$eaf.exposure,1-har$eaf.exposure)

    need_result$PPH1<-result[["summary"]][["PP.H1.abf"]]
    need_result$PPH2<-result[["summary"]][["PP.H2.abf"]]
    need_result$PPH3<-result[["summary"]][["PP.H3.abf"]]

    coloc_res<-rbind(coloc_res,need_result)
    rm(metabolite)
    rm(input)
  }
}

coloc_res<-coloc_res[-1,]
```

**Analysis block.** Snoring adjusted for BMI.

```{r coloc-01-08-snoring-adj-bmi}
# Source file: 1_colocalization_abf_500kb.Rmd
load(file.path(sleep_gwas_dir, "32060260", "snoring_adjBMI_UKB_2018_allSNP_hg38.RData"))
snoring_adjBMI <- get("dat_allSNP_hg38")
rm(dat_allSNP_hg38)

# Initialize the colocalization summary table

for (sleepty in c("snoring_adjBMI")) {
  
  # Select metabolites significant for this sleep trait
  signif_res<-subset(all_res,all_res$outcome=="snoringadjBMI")
  
  id<-unique(signif_res$exposure)
  
  snoring_adjBMI<- snoring_adjBMI[order(snoring_adjBMI$P,decreasing = FALSE),]
  snoring_adjBMI<- snoring_adjBMI[!duplicated(snoring_adjBMI$SNP),]
  
  for (metaboliteid in id) {
    metabolite<-fread(paste(dat_dir,"GCST",metaboliteid,".tsv.gz",sep = ""))
    
    metabolite<- metabolite[order(metabolite$p_value,decreasing = FALSE),]
    metabolite<- metabolite[!duplicated(metabolite$variant_id),]

                                 decreasing = FALSE),][1,]$chr.exposure

                                 decreasing = FALSE),][1,]$pos.exposure
    
    metabolite<-subset(metabolite,base_pair_location>top_bp-500000 & base_pair_location<top_bp+500000 & chromosome==top_chr)

    input <- merge(sleept, metabolite, by="SNP", 
                     all=FALSE, suffixes=c(".sl",".mt"))
    
    metabolite_format<-format_data(input,type = "exposure",snps = NULL,header = TRUE,snp_col = "SNP",chr_col = "chromosome",pos_col = "base_pair_location",effect_allele_col = "effect_allele",other_allele_col = "other_allele",eaf_col = "effect_allele_frequency",beta_col = "beta",se_col = "standard_error",pval_col = "p_value")

    har<-harmonise_data(metabolite_format,sleep_format,action = 2)
    har<-subset(har,har$mr_keep==TRUE)

    result <- coloc.abf(dataset1=list(snp=har$SNP,beta=har$beta.outcome,
                                      varbeta=(har$se.outcome)^2,position=har$pos.outcome, 
                                      type="cc"), 
                        dataset2=list(snp=har$SNP,beta=har$beta.exposure,
                                      varbeta=(har$se.exposure)^2,position=har$pos.exposure,
                                      type="quant",N=metabolite_N,MAF=har$MAF))
  
    need_result=(result$results %>% dplyr::arrange(desc(SNP.PP.H4)))[1,]
    
    #record results
    need_result$metabolite<-metaboliteid
    need_result$sleep<-sleepty
    need_result$nsnps<-result[["summary"]][["nsnps"]]
    need_result$PPH0<-result[["summary"]][["PP.H0.abf"]]
    need_result$PPH1<-result[["summary"]][["PP.H1.abf"]]
    need_result$PPH2<-result[["summary"]][["PP.H2.abf"]]
    need_result$PPH3<-result[["summary"]][["PP.H3.abf"]]
    need_result$PPH4<-result[["summary"]][["PP.H4.abf"]]
  
    coloc_res<-rbind(coloc_res,need_result)
    rm(metabolite)
    rm(input)
  }
}
```

```{r coloc-01-13-napping}
    metabolite<-fread(paste(dat_dir,"GCST",metaboliteid,".tsv.gz",sep = ""))
    
    metabolite<- metabolite[order(metabolite$p_value,decreasing = FALSE),]
    metabolite<- metabolite[!duplicated(metabolite$variant_id),]
    
    setnames(metabolite,"variant_id","SNP")
    
    metabolite_N<-catalog[catalog$exposure==metaboliteid,][[2]]
    
    load(paste(file.path(mr_output_dir, "harmonise_data"), "/", metaboliteid, "_napping_har3.RData", sep = ""))
    top_chr<- exp_out_har3[order(exp_out_har3$pval.exposure,
                                 decreasing = FALSE),][1,]$chr.exposure
    top_bp<- exp_out_har3[order(exp_out_har3$pval.exposure,
                                 decreasing = FALSE),][1,]$pos.exposure
    
    metabolite<-subset(metabolite,base_pair_location>top_bp-500000 & base_pair_location<top_bp+500000 & chromosome==top_chr)
    sleept<-subset(napping,BP>top_bp-500000 & BP<top_bp+500000 & CHR==top_chr)
    
    input <- merge(sleept, metabolite, by="SNP", 
                     all=FALSE, suffixes=c(".sl",".mt"))
    
    metabolite_format<-format_data(input,type = "exposure",snps = NULL,header = TRUE,snp_col = "SNP",chr_col = "chromosome",pos_col = "base_pair_location",effect_allele_col = "effect_allele",other_allele_col = "other_allele",eaf_col = "effect_allele_frequency",beta_col = "beta",se_col = "standard_error",pval_col = "p_value")
    sleep_format<-format_data(input,type = "outcome",snps = input$SNP,header = TRUE,snp_col = "SNP",chr_col = "CHR",pos_col = "BP",effect_allele_col = "Effect_Allele",other_allele_col = "Other_Allele",eaf_col = "EAF",beta_col = "BETA",se_col = "BETA_SE",pval_col = "P")
    har<-harmonise_data(metabolite_format,sleep_format,action = 2)
    har<-subset(har,har$mr_keep==TRUE)
    har$MAF_e<-ifelse(har$eaf.exposure<0.5,har$eaf.exposure,1-har$eaf.exposure)
    har$MAF_o<-ifelse(har$eaf.outcome<0.5,har$eaf.outcome,1-har$eaf.outcome)

    result <- coloc.abf(dataset1=list(snp=har$SNP,beta=har$beta.outcome,
                                      varbeta=(har$se.outcome)^2,position=har$pos.outcome, 
                                      type="quant",N=452633,MAF=har$MAF_o), 
                        dataset2=list(snp=har$SNP,beta=har$beta.exposure,
                                      varbeta=(har$se.exposure)^2,position=har$pos.exposure,
                                      type="quant",N=metabolite_N,MAF=har$MAF_e))
  
    need_result=(result$results %>% dplyr::arrange(desc(SNP.PP.H4)))[1,]
    
    #record results
    need_result$metabolite<-metaboliteid
    need_result$sleep<-sleepty
    need_result$nsnps<-result[["summary"]][["nsnps"]]
    need_result$PPH0<-result[["summary"]][["PP.H0.abf"]]
    need_result$PPH1<-result[["summary"]][["PP.H1.abf"]]
    need_result$PPH2<-result[["summary"]][["PP.H2.abf"]]
    need_result$PPH3<-result[["summary"]][["PP.H3.abf"]]
    need_result$PPH4<-result[["summary"]][["PP.H4.abf"]]
  
    coloc_res<-rbind(coloc_res,need_result)
    rm(metabolite)
    rm(input)
  }
}

coloc_res<-coloc_res[-1,]

write.csv(coloc_res,file = file.path(file_dir, "metabolite_napping_colocalization_500kb_res.csv"))

rm(napping)
```

## 2. Nearest genes for significant colocalization SNPs

This section annotates significant SNPs with genes within 100 kb and selects the nearest gene for each SNP.

```{r coloc-02-01-nearest-genes}
# Source file: 2_significantRSID_100kb_genesLIST_NearestGene.Rmd
dat<-read_excel(file.path(reference_dir, "colocalization_sigsnpinfo.xlsx"), sheet = "Sheet1")

res<-find_nearest_gene(dat, flanking = 100, build = "hg38",
  collapse = FALSE, snp = "SNP", chr = "CHR",
  bp = "POS")

res$abs_distance<-NA
temp<-subset(res,res$distance=="intergenic")
for (i in 1:nrow(temp)) {
  dsstart<-temp[i,"position"]-temp[i,"geneSTART"]
  dsstop<-temp[i,"geneSTOP"]-temp[i,"position"]
  temp[i,"abs_distance"]<-abs(ifelse(dsstart<dsstop,dsstart,dsstop))
}

res<-subset(res,res$distance!="intergenic")
res$distance<-as.integer(res$distance)
for (i in 1:nrow(res)) {
  res[i,"abs_distance"]<-abs(res[i,"distance"])
}

res<-rbind(res,temp)

res_nearestgene<-data.frame(rsid=NA,Gene=NA,distance=NA)
i<-1
for (rs in unique(res$rsid)) {
  res_nearestgene[i+1,]<-NA
  temp<-subset(res,res$rsid==rs)
  nearest_distance<-min(temp$abs_distance)
  res_nearestgene[i,"rsid"]<-rs
  res_nearestgene[i,"Gene"]<-subset(temp,temp$abs_distance==nearest_distance)[1,"GENE"]
  res_nearestgene[i,"distance"]<-nearest_distance
  i<-i+1
}

write.xlsx(res, file.path(coloc_output_dir, "significantRSID_100kb_genesLIST.xlsx"))
write.xlsx(res_nearestgene, file.path(coloc_output_dir, "significantRSID_100kb_NearestGeneLIST.xlsx"))
```

## 3. SuSiE colocalization with a local 1000 Genomes EUR LD panel

This section identifies credible sets in metabolite and sleep traits and evaluates each credible-set pair with `coloc.susie`. The explanatory narrative from the original file is summarized by the chunk purposes below.

**Analysis block.** Select metabolites for colocalization.

```{r coloc-03-01-select-colocalization-metabolites}

all_res<-read_excel(significant_mr_file, sheet = "Sheet 1")

# Select metabolite levels only (exclude ratio variables)

```

**Analysis block.** Configure paths and LD-panel parameters.

```{r coloc-03-02-configure-paths}

file_dir <- coloc_output_dir

ld_bfile <- file.path(data_dir, "LD_Reference", "EUR")     # 1000G phase3 EUR, n=503
ld_plink_bin <- plinkbinr::get_plink_exe()
ld_maf_min   <- 0.01
ld_memory_mb <- 4000

date_tag <- ""

}
```

**Analysis block.** Obtain metabolite sample sizes from GWAS Catalog.

```{r coloc-03-03-catalog-sample-size}
# Source file: 3_colocalization_susie_localLD_500kb.Rmd
catalog<-fread(catalog_file)

catalog<-subset(catalog,catalog$firstAuthor=="Chen Y")
```

**Analysis block.** Functions for extracting local LD.

```{r coloc-03-04-ld-panel-functions}
# Source file: 3_colocalization_susie_localLD_500kb.Rmd
########################################################################
##
########################################################################
get_ld_panel <- function(snps, bfile = ld_bfile, plink_bin = ld_plink_bin,
                         maf_min = ld_maf_min, memory_mb = ld_memory_mb,
                         keep_files = FALSE) {
  snps <- unique(snps[!is.na(snps) & snps != ""])
  if (length(snps) == 0) stop("SNP list is empty")

  td <- tempfile("ld_")
  dir.create(td)
  writeLines(snps, file.path(td, "snplist.txt"))

  args <- c("--bfile", bfile,
            "--extract", file.path(td, "snplist.txt"),
            "--keep-allele-order",
            "--maf", format(maf_min, scientific = FALSE),
            "--freq",
            "--r", "square",
            "--memory", as.character(memory_mb),
            "--out", file.path(td, "ld"))
  log <- suppressWarnings(system2(plink_bin, args, stdout = TRUE, stderr = TRUE))

  f_ld  <- file.path(td, "ld.ld")
  f_frq <- file.path(td, "ld.frq")
  if (!file.exists(f_ld) || !file.exists(f_frq)) {
    stop("PLINK did not generate LD files; check the PLINK executable and reference-panel paths:\n",
         paste(tail(log, 15), collapse = "\n"))
  }

  frq <- fread(f_frq)
  setnames(frq, 1:6, c("chr", "snp", "a1", "a2", "maf", "nchrobs"))

  ld <- as.matrix(fread(f_ld, header = FALSE))
  if (nrow(ld) != nrow(frq)) {
    stop("LD matrix dimension (", nrow(ld), ") does not match the reference-panel SNP count (", nrow(frq), ")")
  }
  ld <- (ld + t(ld)) / 2      # Symmetrize the matrix to remove minor text-output rounding errors
  diag(ld) <- 1
  rownames(ld) <- colnames(ld) <- frq$snp

  if (!keep_files) unlink(td, recursive = TRUE)
  list(ld = ld, panel = as.data.frame(frq[, .(snp, a1, a2, maf)]))
}

########################################################################
########################################################################
comp_map <- c(A = "T", T = "A", C = "G", G = "C")

allele_flip_dir <- function(ea, oa, a1, a2) {
  ea <- toupper(as.character(ea))
  oa <- toupper(as.character(oa))
  ok <- !is.na(ea) & !is.na(oa)

  d <- ifelse(ok & ea == a1 & oa == a2,  1L, 0L)
  d <- ifelse(ok & ea == a2 & oa == a1, -1L, d)

  ea_c <- unname(comp_map[ea])
  oa_c <- unname(comp_map[oa])
  ok_c <- !is.na(ea_c) & !is.na(oa_c)
  d_c  <- ifelse(ok_c & ea_c == a1 & oa_c == a2,  1L, 0L)
  d_c  <- ifelse(ok_c & ea_c == a2 & oa_c == a1, -1L, d_c)

  ifelse(d == 0L, d_c, d)
}

########################################################################
########################################################################
estimate_N <- function(beta, se, eaf, n_sample = 20000, maf_range = c(0.05, 0.5)) {
  maf <- pmin(eaf, 1 - eaf)
  ok <- which(!is.na(maf) & maf > maf_range[1] & maf < maf_range[2] &
              !is.na(se) & se > 0 & !is.na(beta))
  if (length(ok) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  if (length(ok) > n_sample) ok <- sample(ok, n_sample)
  median(1 / (2 * maf[ok] * (1 - maf[ok]) * se[ok]^2))
}
```

**Analysis block.** Functions for locus-level coloc.susie.

```{r coloc-03-05-locus-coloc-susie-functions}
# Source file: 3_colocalization_susie_localLD_500kb.Rmd
########################################################################
########################################################################
cs_info <- function(s, idx_label) {
  out <- list(snps = NA_character_, size = NA_integer_, coverage = NA_real_,
              log10bf = NA_real_, avg.r2 = NA_real_, min.r2 = NA_real_,
              purity.min.abs.r = NA_real_, purity.mean.abs.r = NA_real_,
              purity.median.abs.r = NA_real_)
  if (is.null(s) || is.null(s$sets) || is.null(s$sets$cs) || length(s$sets$cs) == 0) return(out)
  pos <- match(idx_label, s$sets$cs_index)
  if (is.na(pos) || pos > length(s$sets$cs)) return(out)

  cs   <- s$sets$cs[[pos]]
  snps <- if (!is.null(names(cs))) names(cs) else as.character(cs)
  out$snps     <- paste(snps, collapse = ",")
  out$size     <- length(cs)
  out$coverage <- s$sets$coverage[pos]
  out$log10bf  <- s$lbf[idx_label] / log(10)
  if (!is.null(s$sets$purity)) {
    out$purity.min.abs.r    <- s$sets$purity$min.abs.corr[pos]
    out$purity.mean.abs.r   <- s$sets$purity$mean.abs.corr[pos]
    out$purity.median.abs.r <- s$sets$purity$median.abs.corr[pos]
    out$avg.r2 <- s$sets$purity$mean.abs.corr[pos]^2
    out$min.r2 <- s$sets$purity$min.abs.corr[pos]^2
  }
  out
}

########################################################################
########################################################################
run_coloc_susie_locus <- function(har, sleep_N, metabolite_N,
                                  sleep_type = "cc", sleep_s = NA_real_,
                                  bfile = ld_bfile, plink_bin = ld_plink_bin,
                                  maf_min = ld_maf_min, susie.args = list(),
                                  also_abf = FALSE, sens_threshold = 0.8,
                                  sens_npoints = 100) {
  har <- as.data.frame(har)
  out <- list(status = "ok", nsnps = NA_integer_, nsnps_har = nrow(har),
              nsnps_ld = NA_integer_, ld_match_rate = NA_real_, n_cs_sleep = NA_integer_,
              n_cs_metabolite = NA_integer_, summary = NULL, snp_results = NULL,
              minp_sleep = NA_real_,
              converged_sleep = NA, converged_metabolite = NA,
              pairs = NULL, abf_summary = NULL)
  if (nrow(har) < 2) { out$status <- "too_few_harmonised_snps"; return(out) }
  if (is.na(sleep_N) || is.na(metabolite_N)) { out$status <- "N_missing"; return(out) }

  g <- tryCatch(get_ld_panel(har$SNP, bfile = bfile, plink_bin = plink_bin, maf_min = maf_min),
                error = function(e) e)
  if (inherits(g, "error")) {
    out$status <- paste0("ld_panel_failed: ", conditionMessage(g))
    return(out)
  }
  panel <- g$panel
  ld    <- g$ld

  idx  <- match(har$SNP, panel$snp)
  flip <- rep(0L, nrow(har))
  j    <- which(!is.na(idx))
  if (length(j) > 0) {
    flip[j] <- allele_flip_dir(har$effect_allele.exposure[j], har$other_allele.exposure[j],
                               panel$a1[idx[j]], panel$a2[idx[j]])
  }

  maf_e <- pmin(har$eaf.exposure, 1 - har$eaf.exposure)
  maf_o <- pmin(har$eaf.outcome,  1 - har$eaf.outcome)
  keep <- !is.na(idx) & flip != 0 &
          is.finite(har$beta.exposure) & is.finite(har$beta.outcome) &
          is.finite(har$se.exposure)   & is.finite(har$se.outcome) &
          har$se.exposure > 0 & har$se.outcome > 0 &
          is.finite(maf_e) & maf_e > 0 & maf_e < 1 &
          is.finite(maf_o) & maf_o > 0 & maf_o < 1 &
          is.finite(har$pos.exposure) & is.finite(har$pos.outcome)

  out$nsnps_ld      <- sum(keep)
  out$ld_match_rate <- round(sum(keep) / nrow(har), 3)
  if (sum(keep) < 2) { out$status <- "too_few_snps_in_LD_panel"; return(out) }

  out$minp_sleep <- min(har$pval.outcome[keep], na.rm = TRUE)

  snps <- har$SNP[keep]
  sgn  <- flip[keep]
  LD   <- ld[idx[keep], idx[keep], drop = FALSE]
  dimnames(LD) <- list(snps, snps)

  d_sleep <- list(snp = snps,
                  beta = har$beta.outcome[keep] * sgn,
                  varbeta = har$se.outcome[keep]^2,
                  position = as.numeric(har$pos.outcome[keep]),
                  type = sleep_type, N = sleep_N, MAF = maf_o[keep], LD = LD)
  if (!is.na(sleep_s)) d_sleep$s <- sleep_s

  d_met <- list(snp = snps,
                beta = har$beta.exposure[keep] * sgn,
                varbeta = har$se.exposure[keep]^2,
                position = as.numeric(har$pos.exposure[keep]),
                type = "quant", N = metabolite_N, MAF = maf_e[keep], LD = LD)

  ## 5.4 runsusie
  s_sleep <- tryCatch(do.call(coloc::runsusie, c(list(d = d_sleep, suffix = 1), susie.args)),
                      error = function(e) e)
  if (inherits(s_sleep, "error")) {
    out$status <- paste0("runsusie_sleep_failed: ", conditionMessage(s_sleep))
    return(out)
  }
  s_met <- tryCatch(do.call(coloc::runsusie, c(list(d = d_met, suffix = 2), susie.args)),
                    error = function(e) e)
  if (inherits(s_met, "error")) {
    out$status <- paste0("runsusie_metabolite_failed: ", conditionMessage(s_met))
    return(out)
  }
  out$n_cs_sleep      <- length(s_sleep$sets$cs)
  out$n_cs_metabolite <- length(s_met$sets$cs)
  out$converged_sleep      <- isTRUE(s_sleep$converged)
  out$converged_metabolite <- isTRUE(s_met$converged)

  if (also_abf) {
    abf <- tryCatch({
      a_sleep <- list(snp = snps, beta = d_sleep$beta, varbeta = d_sleep$varbeta,
                      position = d_sleep$position, type = sleep_type,
                      N = sleep_N, MAF = d_sleep$MAF)
      if (!is.na(sleep_s)) a_sleep$s <- sleep_s
      a_met <- list(snp = snps, beta = d_met$beta, varbeta = d_met$varbeta,
                    position = d_met$position, type = "quant",
                    N = metabolite_N, MAF = d_met$MAF)
      tmp <- NULL
      utils::capture.output(tmp <- suppressWarnings(coloc::coloc.abf(a_sleep, a_met)),
                            type = "output")
      as.data.frame(as.list(tmp$summary), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    }, error = function(e) e)
    if (!inherits(abf, "error")) out$abf_summary <- abf
  }

  cs <- tryCatch(coloc::coloc.susie(s_sleep, s_met), error = function(e) e)
  if (inherits(cs, "error")) {
    out$status <- paste0("coloc_susie_failed: ", conditionMessage(cs))
    return(out)
  }
  sm <- as.data.frame(cs$summary)
  if (!("PP.H4.abf" %in% names(sm))) {
    out$status <- if (out$n_cs_sleep == 0 && out$n_cs_metabolite == 0) "no_credible_set_both"
                  else if (out$n_cs_sleep == 0) "no_credible_set_sleep"
                  else if (out$n_cs_metabolite == 0) "no_credible_set_metabolite"
                  else "no_credible_set"
    return(out)
  }

  out$summary     <- sm
  out$snp_results <- as.data.frame(cs$results)

  pr <- cs$priors
  pairs <- vector("list", nrow(sm))
  detail <- vector("list", nrow(sm))
  for (p in seq_len(nrow(sm))) {
    pp_col <- if ("SNP.PP.H4.abf" %in% names(out$snp_results)) "SNP.PP.H4.abf"
              else paste0("SNP.PP.H4.row", p)
    ppv <- out$snp_results[[pp_col]]
    h1  <- as.character(sm$hit1[p]); h2 <- as.character(sm$hit2[p])
    c1  <- cs_info(s_sleep, sm$idx1[p])
    c2  <- cs_info(s_met,   sm$idx2[p])
    top_i <- which.max(ppv)

    sens <- tryCatch({
      tmp <- NULL
      suppressMessages(utils::capture.output(
        tmp <- coloc::sensitivity(cs, paste0("H4 > ", sens_threshold), row = p,
                                  npoints = sens_npoints, doplot = FALSE),
        type = "output"))
      tmp
    }, error = function(e) NULL)
    p12min <- p12max <- NA_real_
    if (!is.null(sens)) {
      okp <- sens[, "p12"][sens[, "PP.H4.abf"] > sens_threshold]
      if (length(okp) > 0) { p12min <- min(okp); p12max <- max(okp) }
    }

    ##     top.SNP.PP.H4     = max over SNPs of SNP.PP.H4, the posterior probability that a SNP
    ##                         is the shared causal variant given H4 (normalised to sum to 1
    ##                         over the SNPs of this signal pair);
    ##     top.SNP.PP.H4.snp = the SNP attaining that maximum.
    pairs[[p]] <- data.frame(
      idx1 = sm$idx1[p], idx2 = sm$idx2[p],
      hit1 = h1, hit2 = h2,
      top.SNP.PP.H4.snp = out$snp_results$snp[top_i], top.SNP.PP.H4 = ppv[top_i],
      PP.H0.abf = sm$PP.H0.abf[p], PP.H1.abf = sm$PP.H1.abf[p],
      PP.H2.abf = sm$PP.H2.abf[p], PP.H3.abf = sm$PP.H3.abf[p],
      PP.H4.abf = sm$PP.H4.abf[p],
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

    detail[[p]] <- data.frame(
      idx1 = sm$idx1[p], idx2 = sm$idx2[p],
      hit1 = h1, hit1.PIP = as.numeric(s_sleep$pip[match(h1, names(s_sleep$pip))]),
      hit1.SNP.PP.H4 = ppv[match(h1, out$snp_results$snp)],
      hit1.CS.snps = c1$snps, hit1.CS.size = c1$size, hit1.CS.coverage = c1$coverage,
      hit1.CS.log10bf = c1$log10bf, hit1.CS.avg.r2 = c1$avg.r2, hit1.CS.min.r2 = c1$min.r2,
      hit1.CS.purity.min.abs.r = c1$purity.min.abs.r,
      hit2 = h2, hit2.PIP = as.numeric(s_met$pip[match(h2, names(s_met$pip))]),
      hit2.SNP.PP.H4 = ppv[match(h2, out$snp_results$snp)],
      hit2.CS.snps = c2$snps, hit2.CS.size = c2$size, hit2.CS.coverage = c2$coverage,
      hit2.CS.log10bf = c2$log10bf, hit2.CS.avg.r2 = c2$avg.r2, hit2.CS.min.r2 = c2$min.r2,
      hit2.CS.purity.min.abs.r = c2$purity.min.abs.r,
      top.SNP.PP.H4.snp = out$snp_results$snp[top_i], top.SNP.PP.H4 = ppv[top_i],
      PP.H0.abf = sm$PP.H0.abf[p], PP.H1.abf = sm$PP.H1.abf[p],
      PP.H2.abf = sm$PP.H2.abf[p], PP.H3.abf = sm$PP.H3.abf[p],
      PP.H4.abf = sm$PP.H4.abf[p],
      p1 = as.numeric(pr["p1"]), p2 = as.numeric(pr["p2"]), p12 = as.numeric(pr["p12"]),
      p12.min.H4.gt.thr = p12min, p12.max.H4.gt.thr = p12max,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }
  out$pairs        <- do.call(rbind, pairs)
  out$pairs_detail <- do.call(rbind, detail)
  out$nsnps <- sm$nsnps[1]
  out
}

########################################################################
##
##    Column definitions (English wording, for comments / table legends):
##      nsnps      : number of SNPs used by coloc.susie() in this region.
##                   NA means coloc.susie() was not run because at least one trait
##                   had no credible set in the region (see `status`).
##      n_cs_sleep / n_cs_metabolite : number of credible sets (= independent signals)
##                   detected by SuSiE in the sleep trait / metabolite trait in this region.
##      idx1       : index (label) of the credible set in dataset 1 (the sleep trait)
##                   that this row refers to.
##      idx2       : index (label) of the credible set in dataset 2 (the metabolite trait)
##                   that this row refers to.
##                   One row = one pair of signals tested for colocalisation (CS idx1 x CS idx2).
##      hit1       : lead (tag) SNP of credible set idx1 - the SNP with the largest single-SNP
##                   log Bayes factor within that signal in dataset 1 (sleep trait).
##      hit2       : lead (tag) SNP of credible set idx2 in dataset 2 (metabolite trait).
##      PP.H0.abf  : posterior probability of H0 - no causal variant for either trait in the region.
##      PP.H1.abf  : posterior probability of H1 - a causal variant for trait 1 (sleep) only.
##      PP.H2.abf  : posterior probability of H2 - a causal variant for trait 2 (metabolite) only.
##      PP.H3.abf  : posterior probability of H3 - causal variants for both traits, but two
##                   distinct variants (no colocalisation; the shared association is explained
##                   by linkage disequilibrium rather than by a common causal variant).
##      PP.H4.abf  : posterior probability of H4 - both traits share a single causal variant
##                   (colocalisation). PP.H0 + PP.H1 + PP.H2 + PP.H3 + PP.H4 = 1.
##      top.SNP.PP.H4.snp / top.SNP.PP.H4 :
##                   Taken from coloc.susie()$results (the SNP-level table). For each pair of
##                   signals, SNP.PP.H4 is the posterior probability that a given SNP is the
##                   shared causal variant, conditional on H4 (i.e. assuming that the two traits
##                   do share a single causal variant). It is computed from the product of the
##                   two traits' single-SNP log Bayes factors for that pair of signals and is
##                   normalised to sum to 1 over all SNPs analysed in the region.
##                   top.SNP.PP.H4     = the maximum of this posterior over all SNPs in the pair,
##                                       i.e. "if the two traits do colocalise, how likely is the
##                                       most likely shared causal variant?"
##                   top.SNP.PP.H4.snp = the SNP that achieves this maximum.
##                   Notes:
##                     * It describes WHICH SNP is most likely to be the shared variant; it does
##                       NOT say whether the traits colocalise - always read it together with
##                       PP.H4.abf (and PP.H3.abf).
##                     * top.SNP.PP.H4 >= hit1.SNP.PP.H4 and >= hit2.SNP.PP.H4, because it takes
##                       the maximum over all SNPs in the region, whereas hit1/hit2 refer only to
##                       the lead SNPs of the two credible sets.
##                     * High PP.H4.abf with high top.SNP.PP.H4 (e.g. >0.5) supports naming this
##                       SNP as the candidate shared causal variant; if PP.H4.abf is high but
##                       top.SNP.PP.H4 is low (posterior spread over many SNPs in strong LD),
##                       the shared variant can only be localised to the credible set / LD block,
##                       not to a single SNP.
##                     * NA when status != "ok", because coloc.susie() did not run (at least one
##                       trait has no credible set in the region).
##      status     : ok = both traits have a credible set and the PPs above are valid;
##                   no_credible_set_sleep / _metabolite / _both = at least one trait has no
##                   credible set, so colocalisation cannot be evaluated (NOT evidence against
##                   colocalisation); other values = technical failures (details appended).
########################################################################
new_res_row <- function() {
  data.frame(
    metabolite = NA_character_, sleep = NA_character_,
    top_chr = NA_integer_, top_bp = NA_real_,
    n_cs_sleep = NA_integer_, n_cs_metabolite = NA_integer_,
    nsnps = NA_integer_, idx1 = NA_integer_, idx2 = NA_integer_,
    hit1 = NA_character_, hit2 = NA_character_,
    top.SNP.PP.H4.snp = NA_character_, top.SNP.PP.H4 = NA_real_,
    PP.H0.abf = NA_real_, PP.H1.abf = NA_real_, PP.H2.abf = NA_real_,
    PP.H3.abf = NA_real_, PP.H4.abf = NA_real_,
    status = NA_character_, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

new_detail_row <- function(with_abf = FALSE) {
  r <- data.frame(
    metabolite = NA_character_, sleep = NA_character_,
    top_chr = NA_integer_, top_bp = NA_real_,
    nsnps = NA_integer_, nsnps_har = NA_integer_, nsnps_ld = NA_integer_,
    ld_match_rate = NA_real_, n_cs_sleep = NA_integer_, n_cs_metabolite = NA_integer_,
    idx1 = NA_integer_, idx2 = NA_integer_,
    hit1 = NA_character_, hit1.PIP = NA_real_, hit1.SNP.PP.H4 = NA_real_,
    hit1.CS.snps = NA_character_, hit1.CS.size = NA_integer_, hit1.CS.coverage = NA_real_,
    hit1.CS.log10bf = NA_real_, hit1.CS.avg.r2 = NA_real_, hit1.CS.min.r2 = NA_real_,
    hit1.CS.purity.min.abs.r = NA_real_,
    hit2 = NA_character_, hit2.PIP = NA_real_, hit2.SNP.PP.H4 = NA_real_,
    hit2.CS.snps = NA_character_, hit2.CS.size = NA_integer_, hit2.CS.coverage = NA_real_,
    hit2.CS.log10bf = NA_real_, hit2.CS.avg.r2 = NA_real_, hit2.CS.min.r2 = NA_real_,
    hit2.CS.purity.min.abs.r = NA_real_,
    top.SNP.PP.H4.snp = NA_character_, top.SNP.PP.H4 = NA_real_,
    PP.H0.abf = NA_real_, PP.H1.abf = NA_real_, PP.H2.abf = NA_real_,
    PP.H3.abf = NA_real_, PP.H4.abf = NA_real_,
    p1 = NA_real_, p2 = NA_real_, p12 = NA_real_,
    p12.min.H4.gt.thr = NA_real_, p12.max.H4.gt.thr = NA_real_,
    minp_sleep = NA_real_, converged_sleep = NA, converged_metabolite = NA,
    status = NA_character_, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  if (with_abf) {
    r$abf_nsnps <- NA_real_
    r$abf_PPH0 <- NA_real_; r$abf_PPH1 <- NA_real_; r$abf_PPH2 <- NA_real_
    r$abf_PPH3 <- NA_real_; r$abf_PPH4 <- NA_real_
  }
  r
}

########################################################################
##     -> format_data -> harmonise_data -> mr_keep)
########################################################################
run_susie_trait <- function(sleepty, sleep_dat, sleep_type, sleep_N = NULL, sleep_s = NA_real_,
                            outcome_name = sleepty, har_suffix = sleepty,
                            window = 500000, out_file = NULL, susie.args = list(),
                            also_abf = FALSE, sens_threshold = 0.8,
                            write_details = FALSE) {
  signif_res <- subset(all_res, all_res$outcome == outcome_name)
  id <- unique(signif_res$exposure)

  sleep_dat <- sleep_dat[order(sleep_dat$P, decreasing = FALSE), ]
  sleep_dat <- sleep_dat[!duplicated(sleep_dat$SNP), ]

  if (is.null(sleep_N) || is.na(sleep_N)) {
    sleep_N <- estimate_N(sleep_dat$BETA, sleep_dat$BETA_SE, sleep_dat$EAF)
    message(sleepty, ": N was not specified; effective N estimated from beta/se/eaf = ", round(sleep_N))
  }
  message(sleepty, ": type = ", sleep_type, ", N = ", round(sleep_N),
          ", metabolites to test for colocalization = ", length(id))

  rows <- list()
  rows_detail <- list()
  for (k in seq_along(id)) {
    metaboliteid <- id[k]
    message("  [", k, "/", length(id), "] metabolite ", metaboliteid)

    prep <- tryCatch({
      metabolite_N <- catalog[catalog$exposure == metaboliteid, ][[2]]
      if (length(metabolite_N) == 0 || is.na(metabolite_N)) stop("GWAS Catalog is missing N for this metabolite")

      f_met <- paste0(dat_dir, "GCST", metaboliteid, ".tsv.gz")
      if (!file.exists(f_met)) stop("Metabolite GWAS file not found: ", f_met)
      metabolite <- fread(f_met)
      metabolite <- metabolite[order(metabolite$p_value, decreasing = FALSE), ]
      metabolite <- metabolite[!duplicated(metabolite$variant_id), ]
      setnames(metabolite, "variant_id", "SNP")

      f_har <- file.path(mr_output_dir, "harmonise_data", paste0(metaboliteid, "_", har_suffix, "_har3.RData"))
      if (!file.exists(f_har)) stop("Harmonized MR file not found: ", f_har)
      har_env <- new.env()
      load(f_har, envir = har_env)
      if (is.null(har_env$exp_out_har3)) stop("The harmonized file does not contain exp_out_har3")
      exp_out_har3 <- har_env$exp_out_har3
      ord <- order(exp_out_har3$pval.exposure, decreasing = FALSE)
      top_chr <- exp_out_har3$chr.exposure[ord][1]
      top_bp  <- exp_out_har3$pos.exposure[ord][1]

      met_reg <- subset(metabolite, base_pair_location > top_bp - window &
                                     base_pair_location < top_bp + window & chromosome == top_chr)
      slp_reg <- subset(sleep_dat, BP > top_bp - window & BP < top_bp + window & CHR == top_chr)

      input <- merge(slp_reg, met_reg, by = "SNP",
                     all = FALSE, suffixes = c(".sl", ".mt"))

      metabolite_format <- format_data(input, type = "exposure", snps = NULL, header = TRUE,
        snp_col = "SNP", chr_col = "chromosome", pos_col = "base_pair_location",
        effect_allele_col = "effect_allele", other_allele_col = "other_allele",
        eaf_col = "effect_allele_frequency", beta_col = "beta",
        se_col = "standard_error", pval_col = "p_value")
      sleep_format <- format_data(input, type = "outcome", snps = input$SNP, header = TRUE,
        snp_col = "SNP", chr_col = "CHR", pos_col = "BP",
        effect_allele_col = "Effect_Allele", other_allele_col = "Other_Allele",
        eaf_col = "EAF", beta_col = "BETA", se_col = "BETA_SE", pval_col = "P")

      har <- harmonise_data(metabolite_format, sleep_format, action = 2)
      har <- subset(har, har$mr_keep == TRUE)

      list(har = har, metabolite_N = metabolite_N, top_chr = top_chr, top_bp = top_bp)
    }, error = function(e) e)

    if (inherits(prep, "error")) {
      message("    -> Skipped: ", conditionMessage(prep))
      r <- new_res_row()
      r$metabolite <- metaboliteid
      r$sleep      <- sleepty
      r$status     <- paste0("prep_failed: ", conditionMessage(prep))
      rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- r
      if (write_details) {
        d <- new_detail_row(with_abf = also_abf)
        d$metabolite <- metaboliteid
        d$sleep      <- sleepty
        d$status     <- paste0("prep_failed: ", conditionMessage(prep))
        rows_detail[[length(rows_detail) + 1]] <- d
      }
      next
    }

    ## ---- 6.2 coloc.susie ----
    loc <- run_coloc_susie_locus(prep$har,
                                 sleep_N = sleep_N, metabolite_N = prep$metabolite_N,
                                 sleep_type = sleep_type, sleep_s = sleep_s,
                                 maf_min = ld_maf_min, susie.args = susie.args,
                                 also_abf = also_abf, sens_threshold = sens_threshold)
    message("    -> ", loc$status,
            " (nsnps=", loc$nsnps,
            ", CS: sleep=", loc$n_cs_sleep, " metabolite=", loc$n_cs_metabolite,
            ", minP_sleep=", signif(loc$minp_sleep, 2),
            ", signal pairs=", if (is.null(loc$pairs)) 0L else nrow(loc$pairs), ")")

    base_row <- new_res_row()
    base_row$metabolite      <- metaboliteid
    base_row$sleep           <- sleepty
    base_row$top_chr         <- prep$top_chr
    base_row$top_bp          <- prep$top_bp
    base_row$n_cs_sleep      <- loc$n_cs_sleep
    base_row$n_cs_metabolite <- loc$n_cs_metabolite
    base_row$nsnps           <- loc$nsnps
    base_row$status          <- loc$status

    dbase_row <- NULL
    if (write_details) {
      dbase_row <- new_detail_row(with_abf = also_abf)
      dbase_row$metabolite     <- metaboliteid
      dbase_row$sleep          <- sleepty
      dbase_row$top_chr        <- prep$top_chr
      dbase_row$top_bp         <- prep$top_bp
      dbase_row$nsnps          <- loc$nsnps
      dbase_row$nsnps_har      <- loc$nsnps_har
      dbase_row$nsnps_ld       <- loc$nsnps_ld
      dbase_row$ld_match_rate  <- loc$ld_match_rate
      dbase_row$n_cs_sleep     <- loc$n_cs_sleep
      dbase_row$n_cs_metabolite <- loc$n_cs_metabolite
      dbase_row$minp_sleep     <- loc$minp_sleep
      dbase_row$converged_sleep      <- loc$converged_sleep
      dbase_row$converged_metabolite <- loc$converged_metabolite
      dbase_row$status         <- loc$status
      if (also_abf && !is.null(loc$abf_summary)) {
        dbase_row$abf_nsnps <- loc$abf_summary$nsnps[1]
        dbase_row$abf_PPH0  <- loc$abf_summary$PP.H0.abf[1]
        dbase_row$abf_PPH1  <- loc$abf_summary$PP.H1.abf[1]
        dbase_row$abf_PPH2  <- loc$abf_summary$PP.H2.abf[1]
        dbase_row$abf_PPH3  <- loc$abf_summary$PP.H3.abf[1]
        dbase_row$abf_PPH4  <- loc$abf_summary$PP.H4.abf[1]
      }
    }

    if (is.null(loc$pairs) || nrow(loc$pairs) == 0) {
      rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- base_row
      if (!is.null(dbase_row)) rows_detail[[length(rows_detail) + 1]] <- dbase_row
    } else {
      for (p in seq_len(nrow(loc$pairs))) {
        r <- base_row
        for (cn in names(loc$pairs)) r[[cn]] <- loc$pairs[[cn]][p]
        rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- r
        if (!is.null(dbase_row) && !is.null(loc$pairs_detail)) {
          d <- dbase_row
          for (cn in names(loc$pairs_detail)) d[[cn]] <- loc$pairs_detail[[cn]][p]
          rows_detail[[length(rows_detail) + 1]] <- d
        }
      }
    }

    if (k %% 20 == 0) gc()
  }

  res_tab <- do.call(rbind, rows)
  if (!is.null(out_file)) save_table(res_tab, out_file)
  if (write_details && !is.null(out_file) && length(rows_detail) > 0) {
    detail_file <- sub("_res\\.(csv|xlsx)$", "_details.xlsx", out_file)
    save_table(do.call(rbind, rows_detail), detail_file)
  }
  res_tab
}

## Collect and combine results across sleep traits
coloc_susie_list <- list()
```

```{r coloc-03-16-combine-results}
  key <- paste(ok$sleep, ok$metabolite, sep = "_")
  best <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(ok, key), function(x) x[which.max(x$PP.H4.abf), ]))

             file.path(file_dir, paste0("metabolite_sleep_colocalization_500kb_susie_bestpair.xlsx")))
```

## 4. LD-based overlap and clustering of lipid instruments

For two lipids with m and n instruments, the LD-based Jaccard index is the number of instrument pairs with r² above the threshold divided by m × n. The resulting distance matrix, `1 - Jaccard`, is used for hierarchical clustering.

**Chunk purpose.** Load the packages used for overlap calculation and plotting.

```{r coloc-04-01-dependencies}
# Source file: 4_LDoverlap_Jaccard.R
## 0. Dependencies
pkgs <- c("readxl", "openxlsx", "pheatmap", "ggplot2")
for (p in pkgs) {
  if (!requireNamespace(p, quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop(sprintf("Please install R package '%s' with install.packages('%s')", p, p))
  }
}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readxl); library(openxlsx); library(pheatmap); library(ggplot2)
})
```

**Chunk purpose.** Define the IV table, LD reference, and output directories.

```{r coloc-04-02-path-configuration}
# Source file: 4_LDoverlap_Jaccard.R
## 1. Path configuration
base_dir <- coloc_output_dir
cmd_args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
if (length(cmd_args) >= 1) base_dir <- cmd_args[1]

iv_file     <- file.path(reference_dir, "Ivs_LipidSleepDur.xlsx")
out_dir     <- file.path(base_dir, "LDOverlap")
plink_bfile <- ld_bfile

LD_THRESHOLD <- 0.6
CLUSTER_METHOD <- "ward.D2"
K_RANGE        <- 2:20
MIN_GOOD_SIZE  <- 2
MAX_GOOD_SIZE  <- 10

dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
if (!file.exists(iv_file)) stop("File not found: ", iv_file)
if (!file.exists(paste0(plink_bfile, ".bed"))) stop("LD reference panel not found: ", plink_bfile)
```

**Chunk purpose.** Read and validate the lipid instrument-variable list.

```{r coloc-04-03-read-iv-list}
# Source file: 4_LDoverlap_Jaccard.R
## 2. Read the IV list
iv <- as.data.frame(read_excel(iv_file, sheet = 1))
need <- c("SNP", "exposure")
if (length(setdiff(need, colnames(iv))) > 0)
  stop("The IV table is missing columns: ", paste(setdiff(need, colnames(iv)), collapse = ", "))
iv <- iv[!is.na(iv$SNP) & !is.na(iv$exposure), c("SNP", "exposure")]
iv$SNP      <- trimws(iv$SNP)
iv$exposure <- trimws(iv$exposure)
iv <- unique(iv)

lipids  <- sort(unique(iv$exposure))
iv_list <- lapply(lipids, function(x) sort(unique(iv$SNP[iv$exposure == x])))
names(iv_list) <- lipids
snps    <- sort(unique(iv$SNP))

cat("Lipid metabolites:", length(lipids), "; instruments (SNPs):", length(snps),
    "; IV records:", nrow(iv), "\n")
```

**Chunk purpose.** Call PLINK to calculate the pairwise r-squared matrix.

```{r coloc-04-04-calculate-ld}
# Source file: 4_LDoverlap_Jaccard.R
## 3. Calculate LD with PLINK
plink_exe <- NULL
if (requireNamespace("plinkbinr", quietly = TRUE)) {
  plink_exe <- tryCatch(plinkbinr::get_plink_exe(), error = function(e) NULL)
}
if (is.null(plink_exe) || !file.exists(plink_exe)) plink_exe <- Sys.which("plink")
if (is.null(plink_exe) || plink_exe == "")
  stop("PLINK was not found. Install plinkbinr or add PLINK to PATH.")
cat("Using PLINK:", plink_exe, "\n")

snplist_file <- file.path(out_dir, "iv_snps.txt")
writeLines(snps, snplist_file)
ld_prefix <- file.path(out_dir, "eur_iv")

plink_args <- c(paste0("--bfile ", shQuote(plink_bfile)),
                paste0("--extract ", shQuote(snplist_file)),
                "--r2 square", "--write-snplist", "--allow-no-sex",
                paste0("--out ", shQuote(ld_prefix)))
plink_log <- system2(plink_exe, args = plink_args, stdout = TRUE, stderr = TRUE)
writeLines(plink_log, file.path(out_dir, "eur_iv.plink.log"))

kept_snps    <- trimws(readLines(paste0(ld_prefix, ".snplist")))
missing_snps <- setdiff(snps, kept_snps)
cat("SNPs found in the reference panel:", length(kept_snps), "/", length(snps), "\n")
if (length(missing_snps) > 0)
  cat("Warning: the following SNPs are absent from the reference panel; LD is set to 0:\n  ",
      paste(missing_snps, collapse = ", "), "\n")

## 4. Read and label the r-squared matrix
ld_mat <- as.matrix(read.table(paste0(ld_prefix, ".ld"), header = FALSE))
if (length(kept_snps) != nrow(ld_mat))
  stop("The LD-matrix dimensions do not match the SNP list; check the PLINK output.")
dimnames(ld_mat) <- list(kept_snps, kept_snps)
diag(ld_mat) <- 1
ld_mat[is.na(ld_mat)] <- 0
```

**Chunk purpose.** Calculate LD-based Jaccard overlap for every pair of lipids.

```{r coloc-04-05-pairwise-jaccard}
# Source file: 4_LDoverlap_Jaccard.R
## 5. Pairwise Jaccard overlap between lipids
pairwise_jaccard <- function(a, b, ld, thr) {
  a <- intersect(a, rownames(ld))
  b <- intersect(b, rownames(ld))
  m <- length(a); n <- length(b)
  if (m == 0 || n == 0)
    return(list(J = NA_real_, n_hit = NA_integer_, m = m, n = n,
                n_same = NA_integer_, maxLD = NA_real_))
  sub   <- ld[a, b, drop = FALSE]
  n_hit <- sum(sub > thr)
  list(J = n_hit / (m * n), n_hit = n_hit, m = m, n = n,
       n_same = length(intersect(a, b)), maxLD = max(sub, na.rm = TRUE))
}

J    <- matrix(NA_real_, length(lipids), length(lipids),
               dimnames = list(lipids, lipids))
long <- list()
for (i in seq_along(lipids)) {
  for (j in seq_along(lipids)) {
    r <- pairwise_jaccard(iv_list[[i]], iv_list[[j]], ld_mat, LD_THRESHOLD)
    J[i, j] <- r$J
    if (i <= j) {
      long[[length(long) + 1]] <- data.frame(
        Lipid_A              = lipids[i],
        Lipid_B              = lipids[j],
        n_IV_A               = r$m,
        n_IV_B               = r$n,
        n_IV_pairs           = r$m * r$n,
        n_pairs_LD_gt_thr    = r$n_hit,
        n_shared_IV_same_SNP = r$n_same,
        max_LD_r2            = r$maxLD,
        LD_threshold         = LD_THRESHOLD,
        Jaccard_LD           = r$J,
        stringsAsFactors     = FALSE)
    }
  }
}
long_df <- do.call(rbind, long)
rownames(long_df) <- NULL
```

**Chunk purpose.** Cluster lipids using distance 1 - Jaccard and select the cluster count.

```{r coloc-04-06-hierarchical-clustering}
# Source file: 4_LDoverlap_Jaccard.R
D  <- as.dist(1 - J)
hc <- hclust(D, method = CLUSTER_METHOD)

ks      <- K_RANGE[K_RANGE < length(lipids)]
sel_tbl <- do.call(rbind, lapply(ks, function(k) {
  g  <- cutree(hc, k = k)
  sz <- as.integer(table(g))
  n_good <- sum(sz[sz >= MIN_GOOD_SIZE & sz <= MAX_GOOD_SIZE])
  data.frame(k = k, n_cluster = length(sz), min_size = min(sz), max_size = max(sz),
             n_singletons = sum(sz == 1),
             n_in_good_clusters = n_good,
             n_outside_good = length(lipids) - n_good,
             mean_silhouette = round(mean(cluster::silhouette(g, D)[, 3]), 4),
             sizes = paste(sort(sz, decreasing = TRUE), collapse = ","))
}))
ord   <- order(sel_tbl$n_outside_good, -sel_tbl$mean_silhouette)
k_use <- sel_tbl$k[ord[1]]

linkage_cmp <- do.call(rbind, lapply(
  c("ward.D2", "average", "complete", "single", "mcquitty"), function(m) {
    h <- hclust(D, method = m)
    tt <- do.call(rbind, lapply(ks, function(k) {
      g  <- cutree(h, k = k); sz <- as.integer(table(g))
      n_good <- sum(sz[sz >= MIN_GOOD_SIZE & sz <= MAX_GOOD_SIZE])
      data.frame(k = k, n_outside_good = length(lipids) - n_good,
                 mean_silhouette = mean(cluster::silhouette(g, D)[, 3]))
    }))
    b  <- tt[order(tt$n_outside_good, -tt$mean_silhouette)[1], ]
    data.frame(linkage = m, best_k = b$k,
               n_metabolites_outside_good_clusters = b$n_outside_good,
               best_mean_silhouette = round(b$mean_silhouette, 4),
               size_distribution = paste(sort(as.integer(table(cutree(h, k = b$k))),
                                              decreasing = TRUE), collapse = ","),
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }))

cl_raw  <- cutree(hc, k = k_use)
cl_rank <- as.integer(names(sort(table(cl_raw), decreasing = TRUE)))
grp_lab <- factor(paste0("C", match(as.integer(cl_raw), cl_rank)),
                  levels = paste0("C", seq_len(k_use)))
names(grp_lab) <- rownames(J)
grp_lab <- grp_lab[lipids]

cat("\nClustering:", CLUSTER_METHOD, "linkage; under the cluster-size range", MIN_GOOD_SIZE, "-", MAX_GOOD_SIZE,
    "the selected k =", k_use,
    "(cluster sizes", sel_tbl$sizes[sel_tbl$k == k_use],
    "; mean silhouette width", sel_tbl$mean_silhouette[sel_tbl$k == k_use], ")\n")

cluster_df <- data.frame(
  Lipid        = lipids,
  Cluster      = as.character(grp_lab),
  Cluster_size = as.integer(table(grp_lab)[as.character(grp_lab)]),
  n_IV         = as.integer(sapply(iv_list, length)),
  mean_Jaccard = round(rowMeans(J, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
  silhouette   = round(cluster::silhouette(as.integer(cl_raw), D)[, 3], 3),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
cluster_df$Heatmap_order <- match(lipids, lipids[hc$order])
cluster_df <- cluster_df[order(as.integer(factor(cluster_df$Cluster,
                                                 levels = levels(grp_lab))),
                               -cluster_df$mean_Jaccard), ]
rownames(cluster_df) <- NULL

group_members <- do.call(rbind, lapply(levels(grp_lab), function(cc) {
  m <- lipids[as.character(grp_lab) == cc]
  data.frame(Cluster = cc, n = length(m),
             Members = paste(m, collapse = " | "),
             IVs = paste(sort(unique(unlist(iv_list[m]))), collapse = ", "),
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))
rownames(group_members) <- NULL

off_diag <- J[lower.tri(J)]
cat("\nOff-diagonal Jaccard distribution: minimum", round(min(off_diag), 3),
    "; median", round(median(off_diag), 3),
    "; maximum", round(max(off_diag), 3), "\n")
```

```{r coloc-04-07-write-results}
wb_list <- list("0_Overview"    = overview,

wb <- createWorkbook()
for (sn in names(wb_list)) {

}
notes <- data.frame(Note = c(
  "LD-based overlap of instrumental variables between lipid metabolites associated with sleep duration",
  "For lipid A (m IVs) and lipid B (n IVs): Jaccard = n(IV pairs with LD r2 > threshold) / (m * n)",
  paste0("LD reference panel: ", plink_bfile,
         " (1000 Genomes phase 3, European; 503 individuals)"),
  paste0("LD measure: r^2 computed by PLINK 1.9 (--r2 square); threshold = ", LD_THRESHOLD),
  "Diagonal = within-lipid overlap (fraction of a lipid's own IV pairs with r2 > threshold); equals 1 when the lipid has a single IV",
  paste0("Clustering: hierarchical clustering (", CLUSTER_METHOD,
         " linkage) on the distance 1 - Jaccard; no additional distance measure is introduced"),
  paste0("Number of clusters: k = ", k_use,
         ", selected so that as many metabolites as possible fall in a cluster of ",
         MIN_GOOD_SIZE, "-", MAX_GOOD_SIZE,
         " members (suitable for multi-trait colocalization); ties broken by the highest mean silhouette width"),
  paste0("At the selected k: cluster sizes = ", sel_tbl$sizes[sel_tbl$k == k_use],
         "; metabolites outside the ", MIN_GOOD_SIZE, "-", MAX_GOOD_SIZE,
         " range = ", sel_tbl$n_outside_good[sel_tbl$k == k_use],
         "; mean silhouette = ", sel_tbl$mean_silhouette[sel_tbl$k == k_use]),
  "'Cluster selection' lists, for every k, the number of clusters, cluster sizes, the number of metabolites in 2-10-member clusters and the mean silhouette width",
  "'Linkage compare' applies the same selection rule to ward.D2 / average / complete / single / mcquitty",
  "Clusters are labelled C1, C2, ... in decreasing size",
  "IMPORTANT: 11 single-IV metabolites all carry SNPs in the FADS1/FADS2 region (rs174546, rs174560, rs102275, rs99780, rs4246215, rs174533, rs174556, rs174535) that are mutually in r2 > 0.6; their pairwise Jaccard is exactly 1, so no LD-based clustering can split them into smaller groups",
  "IVs absent from the reference panel are treated as having no LD with any other IV",
  "Method: LD-based Jaccard overlap and hierarchical clustering"
))
addWorksheet(wb, "Methods")
writeData(wb, "Methods", notes)
setColWidths(wb, "Methods", cols = 1, widths = 150)

can_write <- function(p) {
  if (!file.exists(p)) return(TRUE)
  con <- try(file(p, "r+b"), silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(con, "try-error")) return(FALSE)
  close(con); TRUE
}
xlsx_out <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("LDoverlap_results.xlsx"))
if (!can_write(xlsx_out))
  xlsx_out <- sub("\\.xlsx$", format(Sys.time(), "_%H%M%S.xlsx"), xlsx_out)
```

**Chunk purpose.** Draw the annotated clustering heatmap and the cluster-count diagnostic plot.

## 5. Multi-trait HyPrColoc by lipid cluster and sleep-duration trait

Each cluster is tested with its metabolites together with sleep duration, long sleep duration, and short sleep duration. The analysis extracts the cluster's most instrument-rich hg38 locus, aligns effect alleles, runs HyPrColoc, and reports credible sets and sensitivity results.

**Chunk purpose.** Load HyPrColoc and the input/output libraries.

```{r coloc-05-01-dependencies}
# Source file: 5_HyPrColoc_cluster_sleep_duration.R
## 0. Dependencies
pkgs <- c("readxl", "openxlsx", "data.table", "hyprcoloc")
for (p in pkgs) {
  if (!requireNamespace(p, quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop(sprintf("Please install R package '%s'. HyPrColoc can be installed with remotes::install_github('jrs95/hyprcoloc').", p))
  }
}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readxl); library(openxlsx); library(data.table); library(hyprcoloc)
})
cat("HyPrColoc (hyprcoloc) version:", as.character(packageVersion("hyprcoloc")), "\n")
```

**Chunk purpose.** Define cluster, metabolite, sleep-GWAS, and output paths plus analysis parameters.

```{r coloc-05-02-path-configuration}
# Source file: 5_HyPrColoc_cluster_sleep_duration.R
## 1. Paths and parameters
base_dir <- coloc_output_dir
cmd_args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
if (length(cmd_args) >= 1) base_dir <- cmd_args[1]

out_dir   <- file.path(base_dir, "HyPrColoc")
cache_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "cache")
dir.create(out_dir,   showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(cache_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

cluster_file <- file.path(base_dir, "LDOverlap", "LDoverlap_results.xlsx")
sig_file     <- file.path(reference_dir, "MR_Significant_MetaboliteSleep.xlsx")
iv_file      <- file.path(reference_dir, "Ivs_LipidSleepDur.xlsx")
meta_dir     <- metabolite_gwas_dir
sleep_dir    <- file.path(sleep_gwas_dir, "30846698")

sleep_files <- c(
  "Sleep duration"       = file.path(sleep_dir, "sleep_duration_unadjBMI_UKB_2019_allSNP_hg38.RData"),
  "Long sleep duration"  = file.path(sleep_dir, "long_sleep_duration_unadjBMI_UKB_2019_allSNP_hg38.RData"),
  "Short sleep duration" = file.path(sleep_dir, "short_sleep_duration_unadjBMI_UKB_2019_allSNP_hg38.RData")
)

WINDOW_KB   <- 500
LOCUS_GAP   <- 1e6
MIN_SNP_KEEP <- 5
RUN_SENSITIVITY <- TRUE
```

**Chunk purpose.** Read the LD-overlap clusters and map metabolites to GWAS Catalog and HMDB identifiers.

```{r coloc-05-03-cluster-metadata}
# Source file: 5_HyPrColoc_cluster_sleep_duration.R
## 2. Cluster members and metabolite/HMDB identifiers
clu <- as.data.frame(read_excel(cluster_file, sheet = "Cluster groups"))
sig <- as.data.frame(read_excel(sig_file, sheet = 1))
sig <- sig[!is.na(sig$Exposure), ]
sig_map <- unique(sig[, c("Exposure", "Metabolite ID", "HMDB ID")])
names(sig_map) <- c("Exposure", "GCST", "HMDB")

clusters <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(clu)), function(i)
  list(id = clu$Cluster[i], members = trimws(strsplit(clu$Members[i], "\\|")[[1]])))
names(clusters) <- clu$Cluster

meta_info <- do.call(rbind, lapply(clusters, function(cl) {
  idx <- match(cl$members, sig_map$Exposure)
  data.frame(Cluster = cl$id, Exposure = cl$members,
             GCST = sig_map$GCST[idx], HMDB = sig_map$HMDB[idx],
             gw_file = file.path(meta_dir, paste0("GCST", sig_map$GCST[idx], ".tsv.gz")),
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))
rownames(meta_info) <- NULL
if (any(is.na(meta_info$GCST))) stop("One or more metabolites could not be mapped to a Metabolite ID")
miss_file <- meta_info$gw_file[!file.exists(meta_info$gw_file)]
if (length(miss_file)) stop("Metabolite GWAS files not found:\n", paste(miss_file, collapse = "\n"))
cat("Clusters:", length(clusters), "; metabolites:", length(unique(meta_info$Exposure)), "\n")
```

**Chunk purpose.** Assign a core locus and analysis region to each cluster from hg38 IV positions.

```{r coloc-05-04-cluster-loci}
# Source file: 5_HyPrColoc_cluster_sleep_duration.R
## 3. Locus region for each cluster based on hg38 IV positions
ivs <- as.data.frame(read_excel(iv_file, sheet = 1))

pos_cache <- file.path(cache_dir, "iv_positions_hg38.rds")
if (file.exists(pos_cache)) {
  iv_pos <- readRDS(pos_cache)
} else {
  cat("Read sleep GWAS (hg38) to obtain IV positions ...\n")
  e <- new.env(); load(sleep_files[["Sleep duration"]], envir = e)
  d <- get(ls(e)[1], envir = e)
  iv_pos <- unique(as.data.frame(d[d$SNP %in% unique(ivs$SNP),
                                    c("SNP", "CHR", "BP")]))
  rm(d, e); gc()
  saveRDS(iv_pos, pos_cache)
}

cluster_region <- do.call(rbind, lapply(clusters, function(cl) {
  ss <- unique(ivs$SNP[ivs$exposure %in% cl$members])
  p  <- iv_pos[iv_pos$SNP %in% ss, ]
  p  <- p[order(p$CHR, p$BP), ]
  grp <- integer(nrow(p)); g <- 0L
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(p))) {
    if (i == 1 || p$CHR[i] != p$CHR[i-1] || p$BP[i] - p$BP[i-1] > LOCUS_GAP) g <- g + 1L
    grp[i] <- g
  }
  best <- which.max(tabulate(grp))
  q <- p[grp == best, ]
  data.frame(Cluster = cl$id, CHR = q$CHR[1],
             start = max(1, min(q$BP) - WINDOW_KB * 1000),
             end   = max(q$BP) + WINDOW_KB * 1000,
             n_IV_in_locus = nrow(q),
             lead_snp = q$SNP[which.min(q$BP)],
             IVs_in_locus = paste(q$SNP, collapse = ", "),
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))
rownames(cluster_region) <- NULL
cat("\nLocus region used for each cluster:\n"); print(cluster_region[, c("Cluster","CHR","start","end","n_IV_in_locus")], row.names = FALSE)
```

**Chunk purpose.** Extract the relevant regional summary statistics, using a cache when available.

```{r coloc-05-05-regional-extraction}
# Source file: 5_HyPrColoc_cluster_sleep_duration.R
## 4. Regional extraction with caching
extract_from_sleep <- function(d, reg) {
  x <- d[d$CHR == reg$CHR & d$BP >= reg$start & d$BP <= reg$end,
         c("SNP", "CHR", "BP", "Effect_Allele", "Other_Allele", "BETA", "BETA_SE")]
  data.frame(key = paste0(x$CHR, ":", x$BP), SNP = as.character(x$SNP),
             CHR = x$CHR, BP = x$BP,
             EA = toupper(x$Effect_Allele), OA = toupper(x$Other_Allele),
             beta = as.numeric(x$BETA), se = as.numeric(x$BETA_SE),
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

extract_from_meta <- function(d, reg) {
  x <- d[chromosome == reg$CHR & base_pair_location >= reg$start &
           base_pair_location <= reg$end,
         c("chromosome", "base_pair_location", "variant_id",
           "effect_allele", "other_allele", "beta", "standard_error")]
  data.frame(key = paste0(x$chromosome, ":", x$base_pair_location),
             SNP = as.character(x$variant_id),
             CHR = x$chromosome, BP = x$base_pair_location,
             EA = toupper(x$effect_allele), OA = toupper(x$other_allele),
             beta = as.numeric(x$beta), se = as.numeric(x$standard_error),
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

for (tr in names(sleep_files)) {
  cf <- file.path(cache_dir, paste0("sleep_", gsub("[^A-Za-z]+", "_", tr), ".rds"))
  if (file.exists(cf)) { cat("Cache hit:", basename(cf), "\n"); next }
  cat("Reading sleep GWAS:", tr, "...\n")
  e <- new.env(); load(sleep_files[[tr]], envir = e)
  d <- get(ls(e)[1], envir = e); rm(e)
  out <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(cluster_region)), function(i)
    extract_from_sleep(d, cluster_region[i, ]))
  names(out) <- cluster_region$Cluster
  saveRDS(out, cf)
  rm(d, out); gc()
}

for (i in seq_len(nrow(meta_info))) {
  cf <- file.path(cache_dir, paste0("meta_", meta_info$GCST[i], ".rds"))
  if (file.exists(cf)) next
  reg <- cluster_region[cluster_region$Cluster == meta_info$Cluster[i], ]
  cat(sprintf("Reading metabolite GWAS %s (%s) ...\n", meta_info$GCST[i], meta_info$Exposure[i]))
  d <- fread(meta_info$gw_file[i],
             select = c("chromosome", "base_pair_location", "variant_id",
                        "effect_allele", "other_allele", "beta", "standard_error"))
  saveRDS(extract_from_meta(d, reg), cf)
  rm(d); gc()
}
cat("Regional extraction completed.\n")
```

**Chunk purpose.** Align effect alleles, run HyPrColoc, and calculate 95% credible sets.

```{r coloc-05-06-align-and-hyprcoloc}
# Source file: 5_HyPrColoc_cluster_sleep_duration.R
## 5. Allele alignment and HyPrColoc
align_traits <- function(traits, ref_name) {
  keys <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(traits, function(x) x$key))
  if (length(keys) < MIN_SNP_KEEP) return(NULL)
  ref <- traits[[ref_name]]; ref <- ref[match(keys, ref$key), ]
  b <- matrix(NA_real_, length(keys), length(traits),
              dimnames = list(keys, names(traits)))
  s <- b
  for (tn in names(traits)) {
    x <- traits[[tn]][match(keys, traits[[tn]]$key), ]
    same <- x$EA == ref$EA & x$OA == ref$OA
    flip <- x$EA == ref$OA & x$OA == ref$EA
    v <- ifelse(same, x$beta, ifelse(flip, -x$beta, NA_real_))
    b[, tn] <- v
    s[, tn] <- x$se
  }
  keep <- stats::complete.cases(b) & stats::complete.cases(s)
  list(betas = b[keep, , drop = FALSE], ses = s[keep, , drop = FALSE])
}

sleep_cache <- lapply(names(sleep_files), function(tr) {
  readRDS(file.path(cache_dir, paste0("sleep_", gsub("[^A-Za-z]+", "_", tr), ".rds")))
})
names(sleep_cache) <- names(sleep_files)

all_results <- list(); snp_counts <- list(); credible_sets <- list()

for (cl in names(clusters)) {
  cat("\n==========", cl, "==========\n")
  reg  <- cluster_region[cluster_region$Cluster == cl, ]
  mi   <- meta_info[meta_info$Cluster == cl, ]

  traits <- list()
  for (tr in names(sleep_files)) traits[[tr]] <- sleep_cache[[tr]][[cl]]
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(mi))) {
    nm <- mi$Exposure[i]
    traits[[nm]] <- readRDS(file.path(cache_dir, paste0("meta_", mi$GCST[i], ".rds")))
  }

  aligned <- align_traits(traits, ref_name = "Sleep duration")
  if (is.null(aligned)) { cat("Too few shared SNPs; skipped\n"); next }
  betas <- aligned$betas; ses <- aligned$ses
  cat("Number of traits:", ncol(betas), "; shared SNPs:", nrow(betas), "\n")

  rsid <- sleep_cache[["Sleep duration"]][[cl]]$SNP[match(rownames(betas),
                    sleep_cache[["Sleep duration"]][[cl]]$key)]
  snp_id <- ifelse(is.na(rsid) | rsid == "NA", rownames(betas), rsid)

  res <- hyprcoloc::hyprcoloc(effect.est = betas, effect.se = ses,
                              trait.names = colnames(betas), snp.id = snp_id,
                              snpscores = TRUE)

  rr <- as.data.frame(res[[1]])
  rr$Cluster <- cl
  all_results[[cl]] <- rr
  snp_counts[[cl]] <- data.frame(Cluster = cl, n_traits = ncol(betas),
                                 n_SNP_common = nrow(betas),
                                 stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

  cs_rows <- list()
  df1 <- res[[1]]; sc <- res[[2]]
  idx_cluster <- which(!is.na(df1$posterior_prob))
  for (j in seq_along(idx_cluster)) {
    if (j > length(sc)) break
    scj <- sc[[j]]
    if (is.null(scj) || all(is.na(scj))) next
    names(scj) <- snp_id
    keep <- scj >= (1 - 0.95) / length(scj)
    scj  <- sort(scj[keep], decreasing = TRUE)
    n_use <- max(1, min(which(cumsum(scj) >= 0.95)))
    csj  <- scj[seq_len(n_use)]
    cs_rows[[length(cs_rows) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      Cluster = cl, iteration = idx_cluster[j],
      n_snp_in_credible_set = n_use,
      credible_set = paste(names(csj), sprintf("%.4f", as.numeric(csj)), sep = ":", collapse = "; "),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }
  credible_sets[[cl]] <- if (length(cs_rows)) do.call(rbind, cs_rows) else NULL

  write.csv(rr, file.path(out_dir, paste0("HyPrColoc_", cl, ".csv")),
            row.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8")
  if (!is.null(credible_sets[[cl]]))
    write.csv(credible_sets[[cl]],
              file.path(out_dir, paste0("HyPrColoc_", cl, "_credibleset.csv")),
              row.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8")
  print(rr, row.names = FALSE)

  if (isTRUE(RUN_SENSITIVITY)) {
    sp <- tryCatch(
      hyprcoloc::sensitivity.plot(effect.est = betas, effect.se = ses,
                                  trait.names = colnames(betas), snp.id = snp_id),
      error = function(e) { cat("Sensitivity analysis failed: ", conditionMessage(e), "\n"); NULL })
    if (!is.null(sp)) {
      save_pheatmap <- function(p, file, w, h) {
        if (grepl("\\.pdf$", file)) pdf(file, width = w, height = h)
        else png(file, width = w, height = h, units = "in", res = 300)
        grid::grid.newpage(); grid::grid.draw(p$gtable); dev.off()
      }
      save_pheatmap(sp, file.path(out_dir, paste0("HyPrColoc_", cl, "_sensitivity.png")), 8, 6.5)
      save_pheatmap(sp, file.path(out_dir, paste0("HyPrColoc_", cl, "_sensitivity.pdf")), 8, 6.5)
    }
  }
}
```

**Chunk purpose.** Assemble the summary workbook, data dictionary, and console report.

```{r coloc-05-07-write-results}
# Source file: 5_HyPrColoc_cluster_sleep_duration.R
## 6. Output summary
res_all  <- do.call(rbind, all_results);  rownames(res_all) <- NULL
cnt_all  <- do.call(rbind, snp_counts);   rownames(cnt_all) <- NULL
cs_all   <- do.call(rbind, credible_sets[!vapply(credible_sets, is.null, logical(1))])
rownames(cs_all) <- NULL

cluster_region_out <- merge(cluster_region, cnt_all, by = "Cluster", all.x = TRUE)
write.csv(cluster_region_out,
          file.path(out_dir, "HyPrColoc_cluster_regions.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8")

wb <- createWorkbook()
addWorksheet(wb, "0_Overview");    writeData(wb, "0_Overview", cluster_region_out)
addWorksheet(wb, "HyPrColoc results"); writeData(wb, "HyPrColoc results", res_all)
addWorksheet(wb, "Cluster metabolites"); writeData(wb, "Cluster metabolites", meta_info)
addWorksheet(wb, "Credible sets (95%)");  writeData(wb, "Credible sets (95%)", cs_all)
for (cl in names(all_results)) {
  s <- paste0("res_", cl)
  addWorksheet(wb, s); writeData(wb, s, all_results[[cl]])
}
for (sn in names(wb)) { freezePane(wb, sn, firstRow = TRUE)
  setColWidths(wb, sn, cols = 1:12, widths = "auto") }

notes <- data.frame(Note = c(
  paste0("HyPrColoc analysis (hyprcoloc R package v", as.character(packageVersion("hyprcoloc")), ")"),
  "For each LD-overlap cluster: traits = the cluster's metabolites + Sleep duration + Long sleep duration + Short sleep duration",
  "Region per cluster = the locus containing most of the cluster's instrumental variables (+/- 500 kb) in hg38",
  paste0("Metabolite GWAS: GWAS Catalog harmonized summary statistics (", meta_dir, "/GCST*.tsv.gz, hg38)"),
  "Sleep GWAS: Dashti et al. 2019 UK Biobank, hg38 (sleep_duration / long_sleep_duration / short_sleep_duration, unadjBMI)",
  "SNPs were matched across traits by hg38 chromosome:position; effect alleles were aligned to the Sleep duration reference allele (mismatched allele pairs dropped)",
  "HyPrColoc was run with default priors (prior.1 = 1e-4, prior.c = 0.02) and an identity LD matrix, i.e. the standard basic usage in the vignette",
  "Method: multi-trait HyPrColoc colocalization by LD-overlap cluster"
))
addWorksheet(wb, "Methods"); writeData(wb, "Methods", notes)
setColWidths(wb, "Methods", cols = 1, widths = 160)

dict <- data.frame(
  Sheet = c(rep("HyPrColoc results / res_C1-C8", 8), rep("0_Overview / cluster_regions", 9),
            rep("Cluster metabolites", 5), rep("Credible sets (95%)", 4)),
  Column = c("Cluster", "iteration", "traits", "posterior_prob", "regional_prob",
             "candidate_snp", "posterior_explained_by_snp", "dropped_trait",
             "Cluster", "CHR", "start", "end", "n_IV_in_locus", "lead_snp",
             "IVs_in_locus", "n_traits", "n_SNP_common",
             "Cluster", "Exposure", "GCST", "HMDB", "gw_file",
             "Cluster", "iteration", "n_snp_in_credible_set", "credible_set"),
  Meaning = c(
    "Lipid-cluster identifier from the LD-overlap clustering (C1-C8)",
    "HyPrColoc Bayesian splitting iteration: the first round reports the strongest colocalized trait set, which is then removed before the next round",
    "Traits colocalized in this iteration (comma-separated; metabolites use their names). None indicates that no set met the threshold and the row reports the traits dropped in that iteration",
    "Colocalization posterior probability P: probability that these traits share one causal variant (0-1). The main criterion requires P > 0.5 and regional_prob above its threshold",
    "Regional association probability: probability that all tested traits have a regional association signal; it is required for colocalization and is always at least posterior_prob",
    "Candidate causal SNP for the colocalized set (the SNP explaining the largest posterior share; rsID)",
    "Posterior share explained by the candidate SNP alone (0-1); its ceiling depends on regional LD (for example, 0.5 if the SNP is in perfect LD with one other SNP)",
    "Traits removed in this iteration because they were assigned outside the colocalized set; NA means no additional trait was removed",
    "Lipid-cluster identifier for this analysis (C1-C8)",
    "Chromosome of the cluster core locus (hg38)",
    "Analysis-region start = minimum IV position in the locus minus 500 kb (hg38)",
    "Analysis-region end = maximum IV position in the locus plus 500 kb (hg38)",
    "Number of cluster instruments in the locus (IVs on the same chromosome and within 1 Mb are merged into one locus)",
    "Leftmost instrument in the locus (a positional marker, not necessarily the strongest association)",
    "All instruments in the locus",
    "Number of traits in this HyPrColoc run = cluster metabolites plus three sleep-duration traits",
    "Number of SNPs shared by all traits after allele alignment (the SNPs actually used by HyPrColoc)",
    "Lipid-cluster identifier for this analysis (C1-C8)",
    "Metabolite name (matching the Exposure column in MR_Significant_MetaboliteSleep.xlsx)",
    "GWAS Catalog identifier (the Metabolite ID in the MR table, e.g. 90199649 -> GCST90199649), used to locate the GWAS file",
    "HMDB identifier; 0 in the source table means that no HMDB identifier is available",
    "Full path of the metabolite GWAS file that was read",
    "Lipid-cluster identifier for this analysis (C1-C8)",
    "HyPrColoc iteration corresponding to this credible set",
    "Number of SNPs in the 95% credible set",
    "SNPs and posterior probabilities in the 95% credible set (SNP:probability, sorted by decreasing probability and separated by semicolons)"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
addWorksheet(wb, "Column dictionary")
writeData(wb, "Column dictionary", dict)
setColWidths(wb, "Column dictionary", cols = 1:3, widths = c(30, 28, 110))

xlsx_out <- file.path(out_dir, "HyPrColoc_all_results.xlsx")
can_write <- function(p) {
  if (!file.exists(p)) return(TRUE)
  con <- try(file(p, "r+b"), silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(con, "try-error")) return(FALSE)
  close(con); TRUE
}
if (!can_write(xlsx_out)) xlsx_out <- sub("\\.xlsx$", format(Sys.time(), "_%H%M%S.xlsx"), xlsx_out)
saveWorkbook(wb, xlsx_out, overwrite = TRUE)
cat("\nWritten: ", xlsx_out, "\n")

cat("\n================ Results summary ================\n")
print(res_all[, intersect(c("Cluster","traits","posterior_prob","regional_prob",
                            "candidate_snp","posterior_explained_by_snp","dropped_trait"),
                          colnames(res_all))], row.names = FALSE)
cat("\nDone.\n")
```
